sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the open checkpoint, nominal 27B language model, hybrid attention layout, native context, image/video examples, thinking modes, tool calling, and visual/document/agent evaluations.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration includes a 64-layer dense text stack with alternating linear/full attention, a 27-layer vision encoder and one MTP layer; max_position_embeddings is 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index and referenced safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read headers of all 15 referenced shards by HTTP Range, multiplied each tensor shape, and matched all 1199 tensor names against this index. Exact BF16 count: 27781427952; text decoder including embeddings and LM head 26895998464, vision 460730096, MTP 424699392. Index byte total is 55562855904.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the official Qwen checkpoint
sources.evidence: Safetensors metadata independently reports 27781427952 BF16 parameters. Repository creation is April 21, 2026, which is not public-release evidence.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B license
sources.evidence: Checkpoint license file is Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository news and model history
sources.evidence: Former Qwen3.6 URL redirects here. The retained news entry explicitly announces Qwen3.6-27B availability on April 22, 2026; repository identifies the Qwen team as part of Alibaba Group.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.evidence: Indexed official announcement is dated April 22, 2026 and identifies a dense multimodal open-weight model supporting thinking and non-thinking. Direct page extraction returned no body; indexed text is corroborated by the official repository news and model card.

name.note: Catalog display name matches the official Qwen3.6-27B identity.

developer.note: Official Qwen repository identifies the Qwen team within Alibaba Group.

family.note: This is a Qwen3.6 member of the broader Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official dated availability announcement; April 21 repository initialization does not establish an earlier public release.

license.note: Verified directly from the checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Exact full checkpoint count from tensor shapes, in billions, including vision and MTP. The card labels the language model nominally 27B.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count is disclosed; dense architecture does not justify equating active parameters with the complete multimodal checkpoint.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full gated attention, plus a vision encoder and MTP module; not MoE.

context_window.note: Native configured token context; the card separately discusses extension through YaRN.

modalities.note: Official examples accept text, images and video and generate textual responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default, with a documented non-thinking option.

tool_call.note: The exact model has tool-calling launch commands and an agent example.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Supported by the card’s vision, document understanding and agent sections.

sources.label: Official checkpoint tensor index and shard headers
Official April 22 release announcement in Qwen news

patch.notes: The complete BF16 checkpoint has 27.781427952B parameters: 26.895998464B text decoder including embeddings and LM head, 0.460730096B vision, and 0.424699392B MTP. The advertised 27B is a nominal language-model size. Active parameters are not separately reported. Dense FFNs coexist with hybrid linear/full attention.

summary: Confirmed April 22, 2026 public release and all baseline capabilities. Corrected nominal 27B to the complete 27.781427952B checkpoint count; added verified Apache-2.0 license and dense architecture. Retained unknown active count. Exact decoder/vision/MTP breakdown is proposed separately.
